incoming.subject: Does Relay support custom webhook headers?

Hello,

We need to send a signed HMAC header with every outbound webhook from Relay to our internal gateway. Is that supported, and if so is it per-connector or global?

Li Chen
Vertex Manufacturing

gold_reply.subject: Re: Does Relay support custom webhook headers?
gold_reply.body:
Hi Li,

Yes, custom webhook headers are supported, and they're configured per-connector rather than globally — so you can sign traffic to your internal gateway without affecting any other destination.

You'll find it under Connector Settings, Advanced, Outbound Headers. HMAC signing specifically has a built-in helper there: you paste your shared secret and Relay computes the signature per request, so you don't have to template it yourself.

One thing worth knowing is that header changes take effect on the next scheduled run, not immediately.

gold_reply.subject: Re: Do you take apprentices?
gold_reply.body:
Dear Daniel,

Thank you for writing, and it is good to see you looking early.

We take two apprentices each year on a Level 3 Information Communications Technician standard, and recruitment opens in July for a September start. No prior experience is required.

The roles are advertised at northwind.io/careers and also through the Manchester Digital apprenticeship scheme. If you send me your email address I will make sure you hear when the advert goes live.

Kind regards,
Margaret Osei
Business Manager, Northwind Systems
